description: Complete the posting: pass BODY_JSON from prepare_post_work UNCHANGED and the creator wallet's signature over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. A valid creator signature posts for free (the signature is the gate, not a fee); xPayment is only for a post with no signature, the $0.05 x402 door. A failed signature is answered in words with the fix; sign again with a fresh prepare. This server relays to the same public gate any HTTP client uses — it holds no keys and no funds. Success returns your packet's id and public page; claiming it (even yourself) is free. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

bodyJson.description: The exact BODY_JSON string from prepare_post_work, unchanged.

signature.description: The 0x… personal_sign output over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, from the creator wallet.

xPayment.description: Optional, and not needed with a valid creator signature: the X-PAYMENT header value (EIP-3009 USDC on Base, from YOUR wallet) for an unsigned post's $0.05 fee.
